rules: Specific public API mapping, not raw provider count, defines consumer reachability.
Aggregate membership is public API reachability, not single-provider standalone resolve.
Actual real-world consumer usage and live provider health have not been measured.
Keep deliberate opt-in and specialized contracts even when only one provider exists.
Do not remove or prioritize providers without separate justified approval.
